title: The brief keeps the business-reading rules (post offerings, own name over trade description, people from reviews, large catalogues, USP themes gate), keys research on the rules versions, and carries vision risk labels to the picture bench with measured sharpness primary
steps: S1: From the checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/business-reading-post-offerings.test.mjs packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/domain-name-own-marks-over-trade-description.test.mjs packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/domain-people-from-reviews.test.mjs packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/business-reading-large-catalogue.test.mjs packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/business-reading-usp-themes.test.mjs packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/domain-hero-usp.test.mjs packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/domain-asset-labels.test.mjs packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/domain-picture-links.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/picture-vision-risk-labels.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/site-pictures-photo-shortlist.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/opportunities-build-research-key.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code, the "# tests", "# pass", "# fail", "# skipped" lines and the result of each test whose name starts with one of the prefixes listed in run.tests.
expect: S1 exits 0 with "# fail 0" and "# skipped 0", and "# pass" equal to "# tests".

Every named test in S2 is "ok": an own-post offer with a call to book or buy becomes an offering and hashtags, one-off events, partner products and negated offers never do; a listing name that is a trade description gives way to the logo and handle name; people named in reviews show with a role or after two mentions; a 35-offering catalogue is read whole; USP themes pass only on verbatim quotes of two reviews; the research key changes with BRIEF_RULES_VERSION and BUSINESS_READING_VERSION; brief assets carry isBlurry, hasTextOrWatermark and showsOtherBusiness, and measured sharpness is primary.

selectors.key: apps/tracy-web research key built from BRIEF_RULES_VERSION and BUSINESS_READING_VERSION
selectors.labels: isBlurry, hasTextOrWatermark, showsOtherBusiness on the brief asset

fence: Mechanism only, in code with no model call and no database: the rules, the key and the label hand-off. What a live model reads from a real business is not graded here.

an explicitly sold service does not need a second mention
hashtags, one-off events, partner products and negated offers
a trade description is category words plus a place

dental clinic: two own marks name it differently
club: coaches only reviews name
clinic: a person two reviews name is shown without a role
buildBrief: a coach two reviews name is shown and flagged
Lantern Noodle Bar: 35 quoted offerings are all kept
the model is asked for USP themes
the hero takes the kept model theme
without a model the reading has no USP themes
generic words never make a USP
a review theme two reviews state is the USP
a model's review theme passes only with quotes
the brief's assets carry size, orientation, grade and content
a brief asset carries the lettering and other-business labels
the one existing prompt asks for the three labels
one call per batch returns the three labels for each photo
the brief photo record stores the labels
the brief validator takes the labels as boolean or null
a photo the vision model labelled in full reaches the bench usable

the domain exports both versions
the same research under the same rules gives the same key
a new brief rules version or reading version changes the key
